channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Detroit Lions T Dan Skipper Announces Decision for 2026
item.description: Detroit Lions offensive tackle Dan Skipper has announced his retirement after 24 years in football and will transition into a coaching career ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: Dan Skipper Already Taking First Steps Toward Coaching Career After Retirement
item.description: Former Detroit Lions offensive tackle Dan Skipper is already taking his first steps into coaching, volunteering as an offensive line coach at the East-West Shrine Bowl after announcing his retirement.

item.title: Here’s When Detroit Lions’ New OC Drew Petzing Is Expected to Speak Publicly
item.description: The Detroit Lions are expected to hire Drew Petzing as their new offensive coordinator, but when will he speak publicly for the first time? All signs point to the NFL Scouting Combine in late February.

item.title: Detroit Lions Release Hilarious Dan Skipper Tribute Video
item.description: The Detroit Lions released a hilarious and emotional tribute video for Dan Skipper after his retirement, featuring “Reporting as Eligible,” a TD catch, a game ball from Dan Campbell, hydrangeas, and a near puke moment.

item.title: One Free Agent the Detroit Lions Cannot Afford to Lose in 2026
item.description: Pro Football Focus says the Detroit Lions cannot afford to lose Avonte Maddox in free agency. Here’s why his versatility and production make him a key piece of the 2026 roster.

item.title: Pro Football Focus Reveals Detroit Lions’ Quiet Breakout Star
item.description: Pro Football Focus analyst Zach Tantillo calls Detroit Lions rookie Isaac TeSlaa one of the most underrated impact players of the 2025 NFL season. Here’s why his efficiency and red-zone dominance made him a “secret superstar.”

item.title: Report: Detroit Tigers Targeting 3 Free Agent Pitchers
item.description: The Detroit Tigers are shopping the mid-tier pitching market and have interest in Chris Bassitt, Nick Martinez, and José Quintana, per a report from Evan Petzold.

item.title: Michigan HC Kyle Whittingham’s Contract Details Revealed
item.description: Full details of Michigan football coach Kyle Whittingham’s 5-year, $41 million contract, including salary, bonuses, buyout terms, and championship incentives.

item.title: Detroit Lions LB Jack Campbell Wins Prestigious Award for All-Pro Season
item.description: Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell has been named the 2025 Pro Butkus Award winner, officially recognizing him as the top linebacker in the NFL and the centerpiece of Detroit’s defense.

item.title: Report: Detroit Lions Assistant Had Major Influence in the Drew Petzing Hire
item.description: NFL insider Albert Breer reveals that Lions offensive line coach Hank Fraley’s voice carried significant weight in the decision to hire Drew Petzing as Detroit’s new offensive coordinator.
